ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What will most likely happen to the population of minnows if the population of algae and floating plants decreases?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The food-web diagram shows “Algae and floating plants” at the bottom. “Minnows” are on the right side, and there is an arrow from “Algae and floating plants” pointing to “Minnows,” indicating that algae and floating plants support minnows as a food or energy source. Reasoning: If the population of algae and floating plants decreases, then a direct food source for minnows decreases. With less food available, the population of minnows will most likely decrease.
